links.outcome: Output consistency across three repeated runs of the same referral vignettes
links.effect: Baseline mean consistency 66.4% across models (Perplexity Pro lowest at 61.0%, ChatGPT 5.1 highest at 80.0%); Fleiss' kappa 0.337-0.730, i.e., moderate to substantial only.
links.quote: Overall, the models exhibited a mean consistency of 66.4%.

links.outcome: Accuracy on rare but potentially urgent referral categories such as acute visual loss
links.effect: Accuracy was consistently low in underrepresented categories (acute visual loss, headaches, family history screening); performance gaps of up to 30-40% in rare classes.
links.quote: In contrast, accuracy was consistently low in underrepresented categories such as acute visual loss, headaches, and family history screening.

links.outcome: Change in classification accuracy and consistency after in-context exposure to 957 labeled local examples
links.effect: Mean accuracy rose from 68.7% to 73.4% (+4.3 pp) and consistency from 66.4% to 77.0%; ChatGPT 4o consistency 72.0% to 93.8%.
links.quote: Following exposure to a labeled reference set in the second phase, all models showed improved performance, with an overall accuracy of 73.4%.

links.outcome: LLM classification accuracy on real local historical referrals against ophthalmologist reference labels
links.effect: Baseline mean accuracy 68.7% (2,631/3,831), improving to 73.4% after exposure; model accuracy ranged 65.6%-71.5% at baseline, with weakness in rare categories.
links.quote: In the first phase, the overall mean classification accuracy across all models was 68.7% (2,631/3,831).

links.outcome: Comparison of five LLM systems on the same referral dataset
links.effect: Five LLMs compared on identical 3,831 vignettes; ChatGPT 5.1 highest peak accuracy (79.5%); no comparison to clinician triage or simpler models.
links.quote: However, the highest single-run accuracy overall was achieved by ChatGPT 5.1, reaching 79.5%.

links.effect: Baseline mean accuracy ranged 65.6%-71.5%; after exposure, mean accuracy ranged 69.0%-78.0%.
links.quote: Among the five LLMs tested, ChatGPT 5.1 achieved the highest average accuracy (71.5%), followed by ChatGPT 4o (69.9%), Perplexity Pro (68.5%), Claude Sonnet-4.5 (68.2%) and Claude Opus-4.1 (65.6%).
